The '''Savage Bypass''' was the name of a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] located on the [[Telemur Mesa]] of [[Makeb]]. Outcast [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Suz-Anz]] and her apprentice [[Lyla]] resided in the cave.<ref name="TOR" />
